name: Kasugai Yuma
source:
The protagonist of the story, a sophomore. Looks cold and aloof, but is actually the opposite and takes care of his friends. While seemingly collected, at times he will naturally say perverted things. Quite the [url=https://vndb.org/c1528]siscon[/url].

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/07/21/sukima-zakura-to-uso-no-machi-review/]Warum's Review[/url]]
